description: SPOT A FILM: a video in, the music editor's cue sheet out — the first step of scoring to picture. Scene detection on EVERY frame, and it listens to the soundtrack (CPU, no credits): hard cuts frame-exact (dark, low-contrast footage included), fades, flashes and visual impacts; each shot's brightness, colour, warmth, contrast, motion and mood, with a keyframe JPEG per shot so you can SEE what it shows; where dialogue is (Silero VAD) and loud audio hits; then cues placed where the picture wants music and the dialogue lets it (1M1, 1M2 …: start/end SMPTE timecode, emotion, energy, tension arc, hit points ranked by strength, a suggested bpm that lands them, and tempo_map_input — pass it to doseedo_tempo_map as is). It sees light, movement and editing, not meaning: read the keyframes for what each scene is about. Input: video_key (doseedo_get_upload_url accepts mp4/mov/m4v/webm/mkv) or video_url (public https), ≤ 2 GB and ≤ 3 h. Optional start_timecode (the first frame's, e.g. 01:00:00:00; default the file's own), coverage (0.05–0.98, default 0.55: how much of the film gets music), reel (cue ids <reel>M<n>), keyframes (0–60). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (~1 min for a 10-min 1080p reel). Next: doseedo_tempo_map per cue → write the notes → doseedo_render_score → doseedo_mix → doseedo_score_to_picture. Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running spotting pass — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

coverage.description: How much of the film gets music (default 0.55). Raise it for wall-to-wall scoring (a trailer, an animation), lower it for a dialogue drama.

cut_threshold.description: Scene-change threshold at full contrast (default 0.3). Lower finds softer cuts, higher only the hardest.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

keyframes.description: How many shots get a keyframe JPEG (default 24; the longest shots first).

reel.description: Reel number for the cue ids (default 1 → 1M1, 1M2 …).

start_timecode.description: SMPTE timecode of the first frame, HH:MM:SS:FF (";" before the frames = drop-frame at 29.97/59.94). Default: the file's embedded timecode, else 00:00:00:00.

video_key.description: R2 ingest key of the uploaded video (doseedo_get_upload_url with the file name, e.g. reel1.mp4; starts with "ingest/").

video_url.description: https URL of the video, as an alternative to video_key (a public file URL, fetched directly; ≤ 2 GB).

name: doseedo_spot_video
title: Spot a video → cue sheet
